(deftype Atom [^:mutable state ^:mutable meta ^:mutable validator ^:mutable watches]
  Object
  (equiv [this other] (-equiv this other))
  IAtom
  IEquiv
  (-equiv [o other] (identical? o other))
  IDeref
  (-deref [_] state)
  IMeta
  (-meta [_] meta)
  IWatchable
  (-notify-watches [this oldval newval]
    (loop [entries (seq watches)]
      (when entries
        (let [entry (first entries)
              f (val entry)]
          (when-not (suss.bootstrap/nil? f)
            (f (key entry) this oldval newval)))
        (recur (next entries)))))
  (-add-watch [this key f]
    (set! watches (assoc (if (suss.bootstrap/nil? watches) (.-EMPTY PersistentHashMap) watches) key f))
    this)
  (-remove-watch [this key]
    (when-not (suss.bootstrap/nil? watches)
      (set! watches (dissoc watches key)))
    this)
  IHash
  (-hash [this] (suss.bootstrap/identity-uid this)))
rationale: Mutable fields as the M3 storage foundation, with IWatchable added (#30). As in Clojure's ARef, watches are a hash map (first watch starts from an empty PersistentHashMap, so iteration follows hash order, not insertion order) and each non-nil function is called as (f key ref old new) in seq order; remove-watch returns the reference. loop/seq replaces doseq, which is not a bootstrap macro. Identity equality/hash unchanged.
